name: Photo chapters
look: A short story in three to five photographs, one large frame at a time: the section holds on screen while, under its h2, one photograph the width of the page is uncovered by the next from its foot upward, settling from a slight zoom, and a panel in the page's ground on the photograph's lower left changes to that chapter (its number, a title and two lines). Each chapter has about two thirds of a screen of scroll: the wipe takes under half of it and the photograph holds for the rest. Live at every width on a screen 600px or taller, phones included.
reduced: Nothing is pinned: the chapters stand side by side, each photograph over its title and lines, and the section is as tall as they are.
phone: It runs on a phone held upright (one photograph at a time, the panel across its foot); a phone turned sideways, under 600px tall, gets the chapters stacked, each photograph over its words.

needs.words: 3 to 5 chapters, a title and two lines each, under one h2 and a short lead
needs.pictures: one photograph per chapter, all of one place, product or job, none used elsewhere on the page

height: (hold + 1) screens live: hold 2 for three chapters, 3 for four or five; at rest as tall as its chapters. No --h and no data-screen on the section: the checks read it live as whole screens, four at most.
